notes: M21 G2 spec: Canopy Stalker. 'When this creature dies, you gain 1 life for each creature that died this turn.' Valorous Steed makes a 2/2 Knight token; Pestilent Haze (-2/-2) kills the token and the 4/2 Stalker together (the 3/3 Steed survives). Two creatures died this turn, the token included (it died even though it no longer exists): you gain 2.
